# Wall light switch

- Model: Light Switch, by Jarlan Perez.
- Source: https://poly.pizza/m/drzI0Tg_uKT
- License: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY), as stated on the author's model page.
- Original GLB: LightSwitch_JarlanPerez_CC_BY.glb.
- Modifications: generated planar UVs, separated faceplate and rocker, added worn plastic material, screws, Spanish label and interactive rocker animation.

The albedo texture `Assets/Materials/LightSwitch_AgedPlastic_Albedo.png` was generated with the built-in image generation tool for this project. Prompt: "Seamless aged ivory/off-white molded electrical plastic, fine stippled grain, sparse small gray scratches, faint yellow aging and restrained dirt specks. Flat uniform albedo, no lighting, objects, labels, logos or borders."
